content: Emaho!You who fulfill all intentions,Lord of space, devoid of center or edge,Radiating the light of clear-light compassion,To Tsurphu-pa, I pray.You who bestow the state of perfect buddhahood,To the supreme Venerable One, I prostrate;In the great sacred site of Treshö, an emanation,You were conceived in the womb of a wisdom ḍākinī.Upon completing the ten bhūmis, at the time of your birth,As a supreme emanation body, for the sake of all beings,You granted the siddhis to all sentient creatures;To you, who displayed the manner of an emanation, I bow.At age eight, you summoned the yakṣas;At age eleven, you repelled a great army;At age fifteen, you liberated the enemies of the teachings;To you, who subdues the hosts of māras, I bow.At age sixteen, you went forth into homelessness;You displayed the life story of a great shramaṇa.You upheld the scriptures of the Buddha’s teachings;To you, who built a great wheel of Dharma, I bow.At age twenty, you traveled to the central region;Because you were not deluded regarding the fields of knowledge,You awakened to wisdom through the study of all that can be known;To you, the Omniscient One, I bow.To the glorious great Gwa Lo, Vairotsana,The noble Tashi Tseringma,Lingkawa, Tsurtön, and the others—To the essence of all the practice lineages, I bow.When the venerable Rechungpa arrived,Devotion arose and he came into your presence;You perfected the great power of both ripening and liberation;To you, who reached the end of the oral instructions, I bow.When you met with the uncle and nephew of Dakpo,The Dharmakaya, free of elaboration, was revealed in its nakedness;The limbs of great bliss and union were perfected;There was no dwelling place for conceptual thought.Whatever arises, play as Mahamudra;Compassion arises for beings who do not understand;To you, the all-knowing King, I bow.In the four corners and so forth,You practiced without regard for body or life;You attained the supreme and common accomplishments;To you, who reached the perfection of seclusion, I bow.The foundation of the teachings, Tsurphu, andKarma Kampo Gangra andKamkhyim and other temples you established;To you, who built the seats of the Kagyu, I bow.You restored the seat of Daklha Gampo;You reconciled all the conflicts of Tselpa;You brought the beings of the six realms under your power;To you, the King of miraculous powers, I bow.Through your own representative, the Nirmanakaya,By the rebirths of the Black Hat wearer,You perform the enlightened activity of all the Buddhas;To you, the Karma Kagyu, I bow.To the protector of beings, Sangye Repa, andLhopa Tasgom and others,The sole treasure of all realized masters,To you, the King of Realization, I bow.Everything is your own nature;In you, there is not the slightest inherent existence.Alas, for the disciples of this degenerate age,Not meeting you is a state of compassion.Whatever is tainted, whether great or small,Those who meet you accomplish great purpose.Through the power of your blessings,May I see whatever you do as excellent,Hold whatever you say as authoritative,Merge my mind with yours as one,And accomplish the activities of your liberation.Herein is contained the praise of Lord Rolpe Dorje, composed by the Eighth Lord.
